{"consolidated_memory":"## Missing Step in Funnel Report - Three Separate Incidents

All three incidents affected **analytics/dashboards/funnel.py** in the same component area. All exhibited the same signal: **a stage with zero users appearing between two populated stages**. The reproduction method for all was the same: **build the funnel for the two week window**. However, each occurred on a different date with a distinct trigger, root cause, and fix.

### Incident 1: May 10, 2026 - Missing Composite Index
- **Trigger condition**: Only for accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- **Root cause**: Missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
- **Fix**: Added composite index and backfilled in batches
- **PR/Branch**: #3637 on branch fix/missing-step-1
- **Measured outcome**: Job finished in 14 minutes instead of 2 hours (performance improvement)

### Incident 2: May 30, 2026 - Race Condition in Lazy Initialization
- **Trigger condition**: Only when the input list came in empty
- **Root cause**: Race in lazy initialisation
- **Fix**: Guarded the init with a double-checked lock
- **PR/Branch**: #5584 on branch fix/missing-step-2
- **Measured outcome**: Backlog cleared 36 minutes after deploy

### Incident 3: July 14, 2026 - Missing Transaction Wrapping
- **Trigger condition**: Only for traffic arriving through the corporate proxy
- **Root cause**: Two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
- **Fix**: Wrapped both writes in one transaction
- **PR/Branch**: #6232 on branch fix/missing-step-3
- **Measured outcome**: Error rate dropped from 3.1 percent to under 1 per ten thousand

All three fixes were applied to the same corner of the codebase, so context carried over across the work."}
